Snow Push · Support

A helping hand.

A few answers before your next match.

How do I play?+

Steer your rider across the ice and use the Ram button to knock rivals off the iceberg. Avoid gaps and falling ice. The last rider on the iceberg wins.

Do I need an internet connection or an account?+

The current version is designed for offline play against three computer-controlled opponents. It has no account registration or online matchmaking.

Where are my settings and progress stored?+

Your sound and display preferences, cosmetic selections, and completed-match statistics are saved locally on your device. The current version does not synchronize saves between devices.

How do I change sound or screen shake?+

Open Settings from the main menu. You can adjust the volume, turn screen shake on or off, and toggle control hints.

What happens if I delete the app?+

Deleting the app can remove its local settings and progress. Offloading an app may retain its data. Device or operating-system backups may also retain copies; these are managed through your device and Apple settings.

The game freezes or closes. What should I include in a report?+

Include your device model, iOS or iPadOS version, game version, and the steps leading to the issue. A screenshot is helpful. Avoid including passwords or other sensitive information.

Is Snow Push available on the App Store?+

Snow Push is currently in development. The App Store link will appear on its game page when it is available.
